title: SmoothDisplacementField
description: SmoothDisplacementField applies smoothing to a displacement field over a specified number of levels with optional parameters for spline order, inverse estimation, and confidence image output.

image_dimension.description: The dimensionality of the input displacement field.
image_dimension.title: Image Dimension

output_field.description: The output file for the smoothed displacement field.
output_field.title: Output Field

variance_or_mesh_size_base_level.description: The variance for Gaussian smoothing or mesh size at the base level for B-spline smoothing.
variance_or_mesh_size_base_level.title: Variance or Mesh Size Base Level

number_of_levels.description: The number of levels for multi-resolution smoothing.
number_of_levels.title: Number of Levels

spline_order.description: The order of the spline for B-spline smoothing.
spline_order.title: Spline Order

estimate_inverse.description: Estimate the inverse of the displacement field if set to 1.
estimate_inverse.title: Estimate Inverse

confidence_image.description: Optional confidence image output of the smoothing process.
confidence_image.title: Confidence Image
